news.title:
Federal Bank sees ascending triangle breakout with bullish candle and volume spike.
Stock shows higher highs, higher lows with rising trendline and horizontal resistance break.

Federal Bank's valuation shifts to 'very expensive' due to strong P/E and P/B multiples.
Despite premium valuation, it outperforms the market, earning a 'Buy' upgrade in Mojo Grade.
FEDERALBNK: Future Returns Will Balance Peer P E Trends And Capital Deployment
news.body: Analysts have raised the fair value estimate for Federal Bank to ₹315.76 from ₹293.48, reflecting updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E, along with a slightly adjusted discount rate. Analyst Commentary Analysts covering banks and regulated financials have recently updated their views across the sector, mostly through refreshed price targets and rating changes for utility and regulated businesses.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹17.67 (vs ₹16.98 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.67 (up from ₹16.98 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹145.3b (up 7.8% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹43.5b (up 4.5% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 30% (down from 31% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.6% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 2% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: The Federal Bank Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year Ended March 31, 2026
news.body: The Federal Bank Limited announced that at its board meeting held on April 29, 2026, the board of the bank has recommended the payment of final dividend at INR 1.20 per equity share of the face value INR 2 each (60%) for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 subject to the approval of the Shareholders at the upcoming Annual General Meeting of the Bank.

news.body: Analysts have nudged the fair value estimate for Federal Bank slightly lower to about ₹293.48 from roughly ₹293.97, reflecting small adjustments to assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E after recent sector wide model updates. news.title: FEDERALBNK: Future Returns Will Depend On Peer P E And Capital Discipline
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for Federal Bank slightly lower to about ₹294 per share from roughly ₹295, reflecting small model adjustments to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions while keeping the core thesis intact. Analyst Commentary Street research on another regulated utility stock highlights how external analysts are thinking about valuation, execution and growth in capital intensive, rate regulated businesses.

news.title: FEDERALBNK: Future Upside Will Rely On Peer P E And Capital Deployment
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Federal Bank steady at about ₹294.78, with only marginal tweaks to assumptions such as discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, similar to how recent Street research in other sectors has adjusted price targets mainly to reflect updated peer multiples and refreshed models rather than a change in fundamental view. Analyst Commentary Recent Street research on other financial and utility names offers a useful reference point for how Federal Bank is being framed.

news.title: FEDERALBNK: Future Returns Will Depend On Peer Multiples And Disciplined Execution
news.body: Analysts have slightly raised their fair value estimate for Federal Bank to ₹294.78 from ₹294.66, reflecting small tweaks to assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth and future P/E that align with recent Street moves to recalibrate targets using updated peer multiples and sector inputs. Analyst Commentary Recent Street commentary on global regulated utilities, including the FirstEnergy research cited here, helps explain why Federal Bank's fair value moves have been incremental rather than dramatic.

news.title: FEDERALBNK: Future Returns Will Rely On Discount-Rate Discipline And Steady Execution
news.body: Analysts have inched up their price target for Federal Bank to ₹294.66 from ₹289.65, reflecting small tweaks to their fair value model as they refine assumptions around discount rates, while keeping revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E expectations broadly unchanged. Analyst Commentary Recent commentary on Federal Bank, reflected in the modest lift in the fair value estimate to ₹294.66, points to a broadly steady view on the bank with only incremental changes around risk assumptions and required returns.

news.title: FEDERALBNK: Future Returns Will Rely On Steady Metrics And Prudent Capital Actions
news.body: Analysts have made a modest adjustment to their price target for Federal Bank, reflecting slightly lower discount rate and future P/E assumptions while keeping fair value broadly in line with prior estimates. Analyst Commentary Recent research updates on the broader sector highlight how changes in discount rates and P/E assumptions can influence valuation work, similar to what we are seeing with Federal Bank.

news.title: FEDERALBNK: Future Returns Will Depend On Peer-Aligned Pricing And Capital Actions
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on Federal Bank to ₹289.65 from ₹251.71, citing updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that align the valuation more closely with recent peer focused research trends in the broader market. Analyst Commentary Analysts are framing the higher price target for Federal Bank around how its earnings potential, profitability profile and assumed P/E stack up against updated views on peers and current market research.

news.title: Price target increased by 13% to ₹290
news.body: Up from ₹256, the current price target is an average from 34 analysts. New target price is approximately in line with last closing price of ₹280. Stock is up 44% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹16.27 for next year compared to ₹16.98 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.45 (vs ₹3.85 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.45 (up from ₹3.85 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹37.3b (up 15% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹10.9b (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 29% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 2.8% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 3% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 26% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: FEDERALBNK: Future Returns Will Depend On Capital Actions And M&A Execution
news.body: Analysts have slightly increased their price target for Federal Bank, revising fair value from ₹248.38 to ₹251.71 as they incorporate somewhat higher assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples in their updated models. Analyst Commentary Bullish and cautious voices around Federal Bank often focus on similar themes, such as earnings visibility, valuation support and execution on growth plans.
